title: Although the Ewoks
description: Although the Ewoks were a primitive race, their lack of technology was compensated for by their shrewdness and tactical skills. In a sketch by Joe Johnston (front), an  Ewok scouting party uses strange beasts of burden. The simplicity of everyday Ewok life can be seen in this view oi the interior of a hut (back) by Nilo Rodis-Jamero.
